rationale: No existing spec covers link URL validation. alerts-content-templates.spec.js tests content template rendering, preview, and E2E multi-channel delivery — it does not test input validation of link URLs. The feature has sufficient distinct scenarios (inline errors for bad schemes, NOT_A_URL, save-time toast blocks, template vars, empty URLs, relative paths, mailto validation, control-character bypass) to warrant its own spec rather than bloating the rendering-focused existing spec. All behaviors are WIRED — no fixme placeholders needed.
